body:
OBSERVED, confirmed independently (Opus) after an adversarial audit pass (Sol refuter).

Classic gates the per-format delete buttons on the book having MORE THAN ONE format:
`cps/templates/book_edit.html:55` — `{% if book.data|length > 1 %}`.

The SPA has no equivalent guard. `frontend/src/pages/EditBook.tsx:835-850` maps every
entry of `book.formats` and gates only on `canDelete`, so the sole remaining format
gets a delete button. The API does not backstop it either: `cps/api/edit.py:432-442`
(`delete_format`) checks auth, role and visibility, then calls
`delete_book_from_table(book_id, fmt.upper(), True)` with no format-count check.

Result: through the default UI a user can reduce a book to zero formats — a state
classic's UI is explicitly written to prevent. The book row survives with no file.

Fix shape: enforce the invariant in the API (the UI guard alone repeats classic's
mistake of a client-side-only rule), and mirror it in EditBook so the control is
disabled-with-reason rather than absent.
title: New UI can delete a book's last remaining format; classic deliberately prevents it
